20: # ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026
21: 
22: A procedural 3D street-racing prototype made with Godot 4 and the GL Compatibility renderer. Cars and tracks are generated from built-in meshes; no external art assets are required.
23: 
24: ## Play on desktop
25: 
26: 1. Install **Godot 4.2 or newer**.
27: 2. Open this repository's `project.godot` in Godot (or import the project from the Project Manager).
28: 3. Press **F6** to run the current scene or **F5** to run the project.
29: 
30: **Keyboard controls:** W / ↑ accelerate, S / ↓ brake/reverse, A / ← and D / → steer, Space drift, Shift nitro, Esc pause/resume. On a touch device, use the on-screen controls. The game is designed for landscape orientation.
31: 
32: Choose a mode and track from the home screen. The garage includes 10 unlockable cars, paint choices, engine upgrades, and wheel-style selection. Race progress and credits are saved locally. Online multiplayer is not implemented; it is shown as a future-update option.
33: 
34: ## Export an Android APK or Google Play AAB
35: 
36: You need Godot 4.2+, the matching Godot export templates, and the Android export toolchain. Install Android Studio or the Android command-line tools, an Android SDK platform/build tools version supported by your Godot release, and a compatible JDK (Godot's current Android export documentation lists the supported versions). In Godot, configure **Editor → Editor Settings → Export → Android** with the paths to the Java SDK and Android SDK, then install templates through **Editor → Manage Export Templates**.
37: 
38: 1. Open the project and choose **Project → Export**.
39: 2. Add an **Android** preset. Set a unique reverse-DNS package name (for example, `com.yourstudio.ultimatestreetracers`), app name, version, and any signing details required for your distribution. Keep landscape orientation enabled.
40: 3. For a directly installable build, select the Android preset and click **Export Project** to create an `.apk`. For local testing, a debug APK is usually sufficient; enable/install the debug keystore as prompted.
41: 4. For Google Play, enable **Gradle Build** in the Android preset if the Godot version/toolchain requires it, then export a **release `.aab`** with your own release keystore. Keep the keystore and passwords private and backed up; do not commit them to this repository.
42: 5. Test the exported build on a physical Android device, especially touch controls, safe-area/layout behavior, and performance on the intended device range.
43: 
44: The repository currently contains the Godot project but no committed Android export preset or signing key. Export setting names and SDK/JDK requirements can vary slightly by Godot version; refer to the official [Godot Android export documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export/exporting_for_android.html) and Android's [Play App Signing](https://developer.android.com/studio/publish/app-signing) guidance for current release requirements.

201: 		var side := Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x) * width
202: 		var a := p0 + side + Vector3.UP * y
203: 		var b := p0 - side + Vector3.UP * y
204: 		var c := p1 + side + Vector3.UP * y
205: 		var d := p1 - side + Vector3.UP * y
206: 		st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(a); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(c); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(b)
207: 		st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(c); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(d); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(b)

736: func _process(delta: float) -> void:
737: 	if not racing: return
738: 	if race_paused:
739: 		if is_instance_valid(player):
740: 			player.throttle = 0.0; player.steer = 0.0; player.braking = true; player.using_nitro = false
741: 		for rival in opponents:
742: 			if is_instance_valid(rival):
743: 				rival.throttle = 0.0; rival.steer = 0.0; rival.braking = true; rival.using_nitro = false
744: 		return
745: 	elapsed += delta
746: 	if countdown_remaining > 0.0:
747: 		countdown_remaining = maxf(0.0, countdown_remaining - delta)
748: 		message_label.text = "3   ·   GET READY" if countdown_remaining > 1.8 else ("2   ·   GET READY" if countdown_remaining > 0.8 else "1   ·   GET READY")
749: 		player.throttle = 0.0; player.steer = 0.0; player.braking = true
750: 		for rival in opponents:
751: 			rival.throttle = 0.0; rival.steer = 0.0; rival.braking = true
752: 		return
753: 	if message_label.visible and message_label.text.contains("GET READY"):
754: 		message_label.text = "GO!"
755: 		message_label.visible = true
756: 	if elapsed > 3.5 and message_label.text == "GO!":
757: 		message_label.visible = false
758: 	race_time += delta
759: 	var steer_input := float(touch_values.left) * -1.0 + float(touch_values.right)
760: 	var gas_input := float(touch_values.gas)
761: 	var brake_input := bool(touch_values.brake)
762: 	var nitro_input := bool(touch_values.nitro)
763: 	var drift_input := bool(touch_values.drift)
764: 	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A): steer_input -= 1.0
765: 	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D): steer_input += 1.0
766: 	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_UP) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W): gas_input = 1.0
767: 	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_DOWN) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_S): brake_input = true
768: 	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE): drift_input = true
769: 	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT): nitro_input = true
770: 	player.throttle = gas_input
771: 	player.steer = clampf(steer_input, -1.0, 1.0)
772: 	player.braking = brake_input
773: 	player.drifting = drift_input
774: 	player.using_nitro = nitro_input
775: 	if player.speed > 13.0 and drift_input and absf(steer_input) > 0.25:
776: 		drift_score += int(delta * absf(steer_input) * player.speed * 0.9)
777: 	if player.speed < 4.0: drift_score = maxi(0, drift_score - 1)
778: 	_update_ai(delta)
779: 	_update_camera(delta)
780: 	_update_race_progress(delta)
781: 	_update_hud()
782: 	if selected_mode == 2 and int(race_time) > 0 and int(race_time) % 70 == 0 and int(race_time - delta) % 70 != 0:
783: 		credits += 75
784: 		_save_progress()
785: 		message_label.text = "+75 CR  ·  OPEN ROAD BONUS"
786: 		message_label.visible = true
787: 	elif elapsed > 1.7 and message_label.text.contains("GET READY"):
788: 		message_label.visible = false
789: 	if laps_total > 0 and race_progress >= route.size() * laps_total and selected_mode != 2:
790: 		_finish_race()

799: func _update_ai(delta: float) -> void:
800: 	for i in range(opponents.size()):
801: 		var rival := opponents[i]
802: 		if not is_instance_valid(rival): continue
803: 		var nearest := _nearest_route_point(rival.global_position)
804: 		var previous: int = opponent_route_indices[i]
805: 		var step: int = (nearest - previous + route.size()) % route.size()
806: 		if step < route.size() / 4:
807: 			opponent_progress[i] += step
808: 		elif step > route.size() * 3 / 4:
809: 			opponent_progress[i] = maxi(0, opponent_progress[i] - (route.size() - step))
810: 		opponent_route_indices[i] = nearest
811: 		var target: Vector3
812: 		if selected_mode == 4 and i == 0:
813: 			target = player.global_position
814: 		else:
815: 			var target_i := posmod(nearest + 6, route.size())
816: 			var tangent := (route[(target_i + 1) % route.size()] - route[(target_i - 1 + route.size()) % route.size()]).normalized()
817: 			var side := Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x)
818: 			target = route[target_i] + side * float(i - 2) * 1.35
819: 		var direction := (target - rival.global_position).normalized()
820: 		var forward := -rival.global_transform.basis.z
821: 		var angle := forward.signed_angle_to(direction, Vector3.UP)
822: 		rival.steer = clampf(angle * 2.3, -1.0, 1.0)
823: 		rival.throttle = 1.0
824: 		rival.braking = absf(angle) > 0.95 and rival.speed > 20.0
825: 		rival.drifting = absf(angle) > 0.45
826: 		rival.using_nitro = rival.speed < rival.max_speed * 0.7 and i == 0
827: 		if selected_mode == 4 and i == 0:
828: 			rival.using_nitro = rival.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) > 20.0

830: func _nearest_route_point(position: Vector3) -> int:
831: 	var best := 0
832: 	var best_distance := INF
833: 	for i in range(route.size()):
834: 		var d := Vector2(position.x - route[i].x, position.z - route[i].z).length_squared()
835: 		if d < best_distance:
836: 			best_distance = d
837: 			best = i
838: 	return best
